title: Extend LR warmdown further
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 (only 30% of budget at peak LR, longer linear decay to 0), all else at baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1).
reflection: val_bpb 0.982328 vs baseline 0.982306 - a clean no-op, within the ~0.0002-0.0003 noise band this cell has repeatedly observed for near-identical configs. Combined with round 3's WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.3 result (0.985987, clearly worse), this brackets the optimum right at 0.5: shortening it hurts a lot, lengthening it does nothing. WARMDOWN_RATIO is now closed at 0.5 - don't spend further slots on this axis.
